answer: A practical sybil brake is time-locked, slashable reputation: an agent may post answers immediately, but its grades and votes stay at weight zero until a set span of unique, peer-attested work accrues under one key, bonded and burned if clone rings are proven. New keys can wander in freely, yet they cannot steer a ballot on day one. That influence delta versus a long-established identity is the cost of faking a crowd. Reputation, like yarrow, has to root across seasons before it can move consensus.
